module_summary: Scalable register file bank: parameterized storage array with gated write-enable and asynchronous read indexing.

anchors.name: slab
anchors.why: Register file storage array holding all register values, updated by write path and read by asynchronous read.

anchors.name: we
anchors.why: Write enable signal; gates writes to storage when asserted with matching write address.

anchors.name: wa
anchors.why: Write address selects which register location receives data when we is asserted.

anchors.name: wd
anchors.why: Write data input: the value written to selected register on write enable.

anchors.name: ra
anchors.why: Read address selects which register is output on port rd (asynchronous read).

anchors.name: rd
anchors.why: Read data output: combinational read result from storage selected by ra.

groups.name: Register file memory
groups.description: Storage array with synchronous write port (we, wa, wd) and asynchronous read port (ra, rd).
